item.title: Delivering Humanitarian Aid in Conflict Zones
item.description: On Jan. 28, the Institute of International Humanitarian Affairs (IIHA) hosted a discussion about humanitarian aid in conflict zones and the implications of funding cuts in Canisius Hall at the Rose Hill Campus. Ruth Mukwana, director of Graduate Programs at the IIHA, moderated the discussion, which was part of the ongoing Conversations with Humanitarians series. ... item.title: Controversy Flares Over U.S. Actions in Venezuela
item.description: Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro was extradited from his home in Venezuela on Jan. 3 to the Metropolitan Detention Center (MDC) in Brooklyn by the United States (U.S.) Army Delta Force and is facing charges for narcoterrorism, cocaine importation, conspiracy and weapons offenses. The Trump administration’s actions have sparked dialogue among nations and the Fordham community... The post Controversy Flares Over U.S. Actions in Venezuela appeared first on The Observer.

item.title: A Look Into New Dietary Guidelines
item.description: At the start of the new year, the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) released the Trump administration’s new dietary guidelines for 2025-30 with the U.S. Department of Agriculture.
